GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled well back and Wide behind Fast Pace 11 Lengths 1000m, never close # always out back

Jumped Ok was trapped Wide Just Off Mid-Field 6 Lengths . got cover midrace. worked forward approaching 400m & Took Lead . Straightened Up 1 length Clear but was on tired legs, claimed by fave Soon After # worked early/good
Slow Out 2 Lengths went Straight Out The Back 10 Lengths . last into Straight now 7 Lengths off, just whacked away # tardy/never in it
Slow Out 1 Lengths , Drifted Back 3rd last rails 10 Lengths 1000m, tailed off from the 600m and was virtually eased down from then on # tailed off 600m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: slow to begin. Vet revealed the gelding to be lame in the off hind leg (1/5), have cardiac arrhythmia and atrial fibrillation (1st occurrence). VC Required and COP.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 4th Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, crept forward 3 Wide from the 500m and on the corner took over but left in front long way out, rolled back to fence under riding last 150m but had break. he did start to tire final stages but held off late challenge for gutsy on pace win # tough on pace win
Jumped Ok was trapped Wide early , pressed onto 2nd Two Wide 1 length . Hard Ridden into Straight , began to tire approaching 200m # worked early/folded
Jumped Ok , controlled race in front 1000m, slipped away from the corner and he was never in danger # beautifully rated
Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, came widest from the corner, Made Good Ground last 200m but from too far back # made late ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced keenly Just Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths . Ridden Along turning for home, had nothing to offer in Straight (lost off fore plate in running) # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back to tail going keenly 8 Lengths . shown whip on Turn , was 12 Lengths from Leader /winner on Straightening Up , Dropped Out (rider stated horse dropped bit near 800m & failed to respond to riding. vet - no visible abnormalities) # poor finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. RR the gelding raced fiercely in the early and middle stages of the event, and then dropped the  bit near the 800m and did not respond to her riding for the remainder of the event. Vet NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths , overraced back in second half rails and in awkward spot 8 Lengths 1000m, stayed back inside before the corner and he started to weave a passage, Made Good Ground last 200m and although behind Clear winner he grabbed second spot # weaving placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 2 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up but Just needed to get a run, angled into Clear last 200m and rider put whip in left hand, kept grinding away final stages and was tough late claiming leader final stages # grinding win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: dipped for no apparent reason near the 800m. Laid in, in the early part  of the straight.
